@comment: output_encoding=negotiate with Accept: text/plain resolves to the YAML renderer. Both values below moved with gin and are the CURRENT correct ones, not a regression: gin >=1.10 emits the RFC 9512 media type application/yaml (application/x-yaml was the pre-RFC name), and gin 1.12 marshals with goccy/go-yaml, whose indent is 2 where gopkg.in/yaml.v3's was 4.

out.body:
user:
  -type: admin
  name: Elliot
  social:
    facebook: https://facebook.com
    twitter: https://twitter.com
    youtube: https://youtube.com
